messages:
maya: Quick follow-up from yesterday's incident: I'm proposing we rebaseline SLOs for the public generation endpoints. Pattern: recurring p90 spikes on cross-tenant tail when QPS > 120. Need owners for remediation + dashboard updates. I'll list suggested changes below.
chris: Can you drop the numbers? what's the window and impact on error budget?
maya: Window: 2026-03-22 18:10–18:45 UTC. p90 jumped to 420ms (baseline 260ms), p99 to 1.2s. Error budget burn ~14% in that 35m window for hosted tier. Spike correlated with sudden cache invalidation and bursty request fanout.
jamal: Thanks. Proposed actions?
maya: Short list:
- Rebaseline p90 for non-dedicated generation to 350ms (owner: chris, due 2026-03-29)
- Add throughput SLO for /v1/embeddings: target 500rps sustained (owner: lia, due 2026-04-05)
- Dashboard: show per-tenant p50/p90/p99 and QPS heatmap (owner: ryan, due 2026-03-26)
- Error budget policy: automated 72h rollback on 10% burn in 1h (owner: ops-bot / infra on-call, due 2026-04-01)
- Runbook: add KV-prefetch step and cache-stabilization checklist (owner: chris, due 2026-03-28)
I'll open tickets.
lia: I can take embeddings SLO. Need SLA wording for enterprise customers — jamal can you draft?
jamal: Yup, will draft customer-facing SLA blurb by EOD Friday. Also recommend we gate rebaseline behind a canary rollout for 2 weeks.
ryan: Dashboard - I'll add tenant heatmap + recurrence detector. Will push dashboard PR tomorrow. Need sample query: ```SELECT percentile(latency_ms, 90) as p90, count(*) as qps FROM requests WHERE route='/v1/generation' GROUP BY tenant, 5m```
chris: I'll own the p90 rebaseline + runbook. Plan: change SLO config in infra, then canary traffic 10% -> 50% over 3 days. If error budget burn > 5% in canary, rollback. ETA for config PR: 2026-03-25.
ops-bot: Incident 2026-03-22-17: alert: latency-regression triggered. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2026-03-22-17
maya: Assigning owners in issue tracker now. Quick ask: people add short acceptance criteria to their tickets (metrics thresholds + dashboard screenshots). :thumbsup:
ryan: Noted. Also flagging recurring pattern: same KV invalidation crop-up on 2026-02-15 and 2026-03-05. I'll include timeline in the dashboard.
jamal: Schedule weekly 15m check-in for the remediation sprint? Monday 10am PT works for me.
maya: Set up calendar, invite: remediation-sprint@redwood. Thanks everyone.
